title: Introduce 'merge-sigil' quiet gate and lightweight dependency curator
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: reduce noisy rollouts during scheduled release windows while improving visibility into risky transitive dependency updates. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) a small, opt-in 'merge-sigil' quiet gate that defers non-urgent merges to configured quiet windows and exposes a lightweight scheduler for release engineers; and 2) a 'dep-curator' CLI that performs fast transitive-dep heuristics, produces a human-readable risk summary, and emits metadata used by the merge gate. Additionally, lint/test pipelines are split into 'quick' and 'strict' profiles so routine changes get fast feedback while release-critical branches still run the full verification.

release_notes: Adds an opt-in 'merge-sigil' quiet gate for scheduled release windows, a lightweight dep-curator that emits dependency risk summaries, and splits lint into quick/strict profiles to speed feedback. Operators: enable merge-sigil via .github/merge-sigil.yml and configure quiet windows. Dep-curator provides a --summary flag for CI integration and a --rules file to tune heuristics.
